For a typical 2BHK interior repaint in Hyderabad, exact quotes depend heavily on carpet area, wall condition, paint grade and prep work. These three currently available options illustrate different switching costs:

Provider	Cost position*	Switching difficulty
Asian Paints Beautiful Homes Painting Service	Quote-based; includes labour + materials. ₹250 refundable inspection fee. 
Asian Paints
+1
	Low–medium: managed inspection, supervision and colour consultation make handover straightforward.
AapkaPainter	Quote-based; typically bundles prep/application rather than selling labour alone.	Medium: changing provider mainly means another site inspection and reconfirming prep/material specifications.
PAINTING SERVICE HYDERABAD	Local-contractor pricing; request a written 2BHK quote.	Medium–high: potentially cheaper/flexible, but you must verify paint brand, coats, putty/primer, masking and cleanup yourself.

*Public sources do not provide comparable fixed 2BHK prices, so avoid treating online “per-sq-ft” figures as final quotes. Berger Express Painting is another organized alternative, offering supervised work, accurate quotations and protective covering. 
bergerpaints.com

Switching tip: get all three quotes using the same scope—surface preparation, number of coats, paint SKU, labour, furniture protection, cleanup and timeline—so switching is essentially a price comparison rather than a scope renegotiation.
